title: Museum of Making Music

services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: Looking for a fun, unique and educational experience? Visit the Museum of Making Music as a group and save! Docent-led tours add depth, insight and interesting anecdotes to every visit. Open Tuesday - Sunday10:00 AM - 5:00 PMThe Museum is closed on Mondays and on the following holidays: New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Easter Sunday, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Veterans' Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Eve and Christmas

services.name: Class
services.desc: In collaboration with the writing team at F-flat Books, The NAMM Foundation and NAMM's Museum of Making Music has created a curriculum built upon the resources found throughout the museum. In this curriculum, you will find: 16 lesson plans for elementary students and 16 lesson plans for secondary students.
